title: The Problem With "Move Fast and Break Things"
excerpt: For a long time, this was celebrated as the mantra of startup innovation. But as organizations grow, the very mindset that fueled innovation starts creating fragility. Why velocity and resilience both matter—and how the best leaders balance them.

title: The Architecture of Trust in Teams
excerpt: Most leaders talk about trust as if it were a personality trait. But in high-performing organizations, trust is rarely accidental—it's engineered. Why trust is built through systems, not slogans.
